sources.name: Kingston Frontenac Public Library
sources.notes: Communico/libnet feed, same pattern as Hamilton Public Library - confirmed live 2026-08-26. Includes the Calvin Park branch newcomer conversation circles (Mon/Tue). Age field distinguishes children's programming from adult.

sources.name: Queen's University Events Calendar
sources.notes: Central campus-wide calendar that QUIC, the Student Experience Office, and every academic unit post to. Was a Drupal 7 server-rendered page (kind queensu_drupal) as confirmed earlier 2026-08-26, but migrated to a React SPA the same day - now scraped via kind queensu_events hitting the SPA's own /api/events?start=&end= JSON route (found in its JS bundle), which is better than the old scrape (real venue + end time, one request for the whole window). This is broad (includes faculty meetings, thesis defenses etc.) - relies on the existing newcomer/student keyword scoring plus a title-marker skip list for internal HR programming (Thrive 365, EFAP, etc) to surface the relevant events.

sources.name: Queen's University International Centre (QUIC)
sources.notes: The single best-fit source for this city, but a genuine dead end for a QUIC-scoped feed. Its own /event-calendar page is a client-rendered filter widget with no feed. Re-checked 2026-09-10: the Queen's campus events API (www.queensu.ca/eventscalendar/api/events, what the queensu_events parser uses) ignores every unit=/organizer= filter value tried and its event objects carry no host/unit field - so QUIC events can't be isolated from the whole-campus feed. Kingston already runs that whole-campus calendar as the queensu-eventscalendar source (with a noise filter), so any QUIC events posted there are already captured; a separate QUIC source would only duplicate. Welcome Week / Winter Welcome Days stay hand-entered in manual_events.

sources.name: St. Lawrence College
sources.notes: International Welcome Session is compulsory for new international students each intake; dates found as static text on the page, no feed. The site's own /events footer link wasn't confirmed reachable - re-check for a real calendar next refresh.

sources.name: KEYS Employment & Newcomer Services
sources.notes: Largest newcomer/settlement and employment agency in Kingston - English classes, settlement program, professional mentoring, the Annual Job Fair. Runs an Eventbrite organizer page (eventbrite.ca/o/keys-employment-newcomer-services-31265455833) that may be worth a future Eventbrite-organizer parser; no specific dated events confirmed yet, needs hand-entry when announced.

sources.name: Kingston Immigration Partnership
sources.notes: Local Immigration Partnership (Community Planning Table); hosts the annual Welcome to Kingston Day / New to Kingston Fair, 60+ partner orgs. No feed - confirmed content gap like Hamilton's HIPC, not an access gap.

sources.name: City of Kingston Events Calendar
sources.notes: Runs on a separate Azure-hosted .NET calendar app (not a recognized platform - not Communico, not tribe), 200 OK but no REST/JSON/ical route found on a first pass 2026-08-26. Festivals used as manual_events below (RoadTrip Music Festival, Intercultural Arts Festival, Art After Dark) were sourced from downtownkingston.ca and the City's news post instead.

sources.name: Downtown Kingston BIA
sources.notes: Shopify site, static events showcase page, no feed. Links out to tmslushpup.wpenginepowered.com/events/ which 404s on the standard tribe REST route - re-probe if it's worth a WordPress parser later.

sources.name: Faith Alive International Ministries
sources.notes: Standing weekly Bible Study (Tuesdays 8pm) and Saturday Worship at 362 Alfred St - no dated feed, recurring program only. Per the no-recurring-events rule, left with an empty manual event list until someone wants specific dated drafts stamped out.

sources.name: TESL Kingston
sources.notes: ESL-teacher professional-development network; page literally says 'Fall 2026 PD planning now' with nothing scheduled yet as of 2026-08-26. Content gap, not access - re-check in the fall.
